note: Entry-point policy of the packed-consumer checks (consumer-typecheck.mjs, consumer-typecheck-no-node.mjs, browser-bundle-neutral.mjs). A specifier is a package name, or a package name plus a subpath. Each entry carries its reason.

nodeOnly.@danielsimonjr/mathts-workbook: Headless notebook runtime and the mtsw CLI: reads files, so its declarations may use Node types.
nodeOnly.@danielsimonjr/mathts-plot/render: Writes PNG and PDF files and takes Buffer: a Node entry.

workerScripts.@danielsimonjr/mathts-workerpool/worker: A worker script. Loading it registers the importing process as a pool worker, so it is type-checked but never imported.

requireExempt.@danielsimonjr/mathts-wasm: The AssemblyScript glue awaits WebAssembly.instantiate at the top level, so require() reports ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE. Use import().

notBrowserFacing.@danielsimonjr/mathts-workerpool/worker: Worker script, bundled as its own entry by the app.
notBrowserFacing.@danielsimonjr/mathts-wasm: Needs a loader that supports top-level await and WebAssembly files; not a plain browser entry.
